name: Flat glass Bridge; USLCI to USEEIO
description: Bridge process to transparently convert from physical units, in USLCI, to values in 2012 producer price for connecting to background data in the USEEIO repository.

processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription:
Conversions to USD assumes purchaser price of $1.61 per square foot and a unit weight of 3.27 pounds/square foot. Purchaser prices are in 2021 dollars. The 2021 Rho matrix values (most recent available), which reflect CPI price year ratios, for the appropriate NAICS sector are used to convert current dollars to the model year (2012) of USEEIO version 2.0. Phi matrix values, which reflect producer-to-purchaser price ratios, for the appropriate NAICS sector are used to convert purchaser price data to producer prices to reflect the basis of USEEIO version 2.0.



2012 Producer Price = 2021 purchaser price * (2021 Rho/2012 Rho) * 2012 Phi



Utilized ratios - NAICS code: 327200/US, 2021 Rho: 0.86724469592567, 2012 Rho: 1.10846254389413, 2012 Phi: 0.743421390586001
